title: A Mechanistic Analysis of Looped Reasoning Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.11791v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reasoning has become a central capability in large language models. Recent research has shown that reasoning performance can be improved by looping an LLM's layers in the latent dimension, resulting in looped reasoning language models. Despite promising results, few works have investigated how the internal dynamics and computation of looped models differ from that of standard feedforward models. In this paper, we conduct a mechanistic analysis of latent states and layer behavior in looped language models. We analyze cyclic recurrence and show that for many of the studied models each layer in the cycle converges to a distinct fixed point; consequently, the recurrent block follows a consistent cyclic trajectory in the latent space. We provide evidence that as these fixed points are reached, attention-head behavior stabilizes, leading to constant behavior - stages of inference - across recurrences. translated_title: 循环推理语言模型的机制分析
translated_abstract: 推理已成为大语言模型的一项核心能力。近期研究表明，通过在潜在维度上循环大语言模型的各层可以提升推理性能，由此产生了循环推理语言模型。尽管取得了令人瞩目的成果，但鲜有工作研究循环模型的内部动态和计算方式与标准前馈模型有何不同。在本文中，我们对循环语言模型中的潜在状态和层行为进行了机制分析。我们分析了循环递归，并发现对于所研究的许多模型，循环中的每一层都会收敛到一个不同的不动点；因此，递归块在潜在空间中遵循一致的循环轨迹。我们提供了证据表明，随着这些不动点的达成，注意力头的行为趋于稳定，从而在多次递归中产生恒定行为——即推理阶段。通过实证，我们发现…
tldr: 本文对循环推理语言模型进行机制分析，发现每层在循环中收敛到不同的不动点，使注意力头行为趋于稳定，从而在多次递归中形成一致的推理阶段。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a mechanistic analysis of looped reasoning language models, showing that each layer in the cycle converges to a distinct fixed point, stabilizing attention-head behavior and yielding consistent inference stages across recurrences.
